messages:
Sara V: Hey team — putting together the canonical checklist for calibration dataset / prompt-set curation for the upcoming quant bakeoffs (FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ). Want to make sure we cover production drift cases + edge domains. Thoughts?
Miguel R: +1. Can we capture both distributional match to prod traffic and edge-case stress tests. Proposal: 3 buckets — Core (70%), Tail (20%), Failure/Stress (10%).
Ahmad K: I generally prefer explicit buckets by domain rather than % only: code, math, chit-chat, instruction-following, dialog, retrieval. Then stratify by length and tokenization complexity.
Olivia P: Also add a PII/PII-adjacent filter step (exclude or synthetic-mask) for shared datasets. And add a policy column for regen vs redact.
Miguel R: Checklist draft quick list: 1) Collect 50k candidate prompts from prod logs (anonymized) 2) Deduplicate to 10k by semantic hashes 3) Stratify by domain + len buckets (<=32, 33-128, 129-512, 512+) 4) Ensure at least 500 examples per critical domain 5) Add 500 curated adversarial prompts per quant family (e.g., long-context memory, repeated tokens, numeric precision tasks) 6) Include structured output cases (JSON/table) 7) Seed/PRNG and sampling seed saved with experiment.
Sara V: How do we pick the adversarial list per quant type? AWQ/GPTQ known to break on certain patterns. Any prior lists?
Ahmad K: For GPTQ we saw issues with high-token repetition and rare token embeddings; for AWQ/INT8 main issues were numeric precision and punctuation-heavy code. So curate adversarial subsets: repetition, unicode-heavy, emoji, long decimal math.
Olivia P: Metric side: report delta on multiple metrics: EM/F1 for QA, BLEU/ROUGE for generative, exact-match for structured outputs, perplexity/logprobs delta for LM goodness, and top-k token divergence. Also add catastrophic-failure rate (generation truncation, invalid JSON).
quant-bot: bakeoff: new dataset bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/quant_calib/2026-03-12/v1 (meta: buckets/core=7000,tail=2000,adversarial=1000).
Miguel R: Good — include prompt templates for few-shot vs zero-shot. Important: keep the sampling context consistent with training/production (i.e., include instruction prefix if product sends one).
Sara V: On dedupe — use SimHash at 64 bits then cluster threshold 0.85 to avoid losing semantically similar but different label pairs. Save mapping file for traceability.
Ahmad K: Also add a small "sanity eval" subset of 200 examples that we always run to detect measurement noise across quant runs. Same random seed and seed file committed to the repo.
Olivia P: For length distribution matching to prod, compute histogram over token counts and target KL distance < 0.05 for core bucket. If >0.05, resample.
Miguel R: Implementation note: bakeoff runner expects JSONL prompt file with fields: {"id","prompt","expected","domain","bucket","len_tokens","seed"}. We'll add a generator script: tools/quant/prepare_calib.py --input s3://... --out data/calib_v1.jsonl --seed 42
Sara V: QA: should we include API-coupled prompts (multi-turn) or stick to single-turn? My vote: include both, but mark multi-turn separately and run KV-cache stress tests (long context + many turns).
Ahmad K: Agree. Multi-turn tests for LRU/KV cache correctness are essential for runtime regressions. Include examples with system+user+assistant prefixes.
Olivia P: Governance: add metadata for consent flagged, regulatory sensitivity, and a redaction flag. Also a column 'production_route' (hosted/dedicated/private) to test routing-specific quant profiles.
Miguel R: Final thought: keep the prompt set small enough to be quick for repeated runs (10-20k total), but store full candidate pool separately for periodic full-run regressions.
Sara V: Perfect. I'll collate into a short repo PR template. Action items: Miguel - write prepare_calib.py wrapper; Ahmad - adversarial examples list per quant family; Olivia - governance/redaction schema; I'll assemble PR with datasets and seed.
Miguel R: I'll ping when the script lands.
quant-bot: note: new bakeoff job queued: job_id=qb-20260312-11, targets=[gptq-int8,awq-int8,fp8-ref], notify=#eng-ml on completion. :rocket:
Olivia P: thanks — can someone add a small README with sampling certs and a sample run command in the s3 folder?
Sara V: Will do. Closing thread for now, please comment on the PR when posted. :white_check_mark:
